title: Resume setup after the installer has installed Yoke
when: Quitting setup or seeing a setup error after a public install
need: Quitting prints setup_skipped and exits 0. A setup error prints setup_failed and exits 2. Both name the installed version and the command to resume setup. Windows directs the user to a new terminal. On macOS and Linux, the command uses the absolute launcher path when the original shell has not reloaded PATH.
